question: Find the value of 1200 ÷ 15 × [45 ÷ (17 - 2)] of 2 + [-2 (1 + 2)]
solution:
Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6cf2901877f7b76090039f191195b8a50cd9731649e23264c5cc839c27a8683.png] 

Calculation:

 1200 ÷ 15 × [45 ÷ (17 - 2)] of 2 + [-2 (1 + 2)]

 1200 ÷ 15 × [45 ÷ 15] of 2 + [- 6]

⇒ 1200 ÷ 15 × [(3)] of 2 - 6

⇒ 1200 ÷ 15 × 6 - 6

⇒ 80 × 6 - 6

⇒ 480 - 6 = 474

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
